Platform overview
SETU Flow is a trade execution CRM built for import, export, and distribution teams. Lead capture, product pricing, quote control, document readiness, and order dispatch — one connected workflow, any commodity, any market.

Setup checklist
1
Activation email
Click the activation link within 48 hours to set your password. Single-use — contact help@setugroups.com if it expires.
2
Organisation profile
Add company name, logo, HQ country, default currency, and trade markets. Appears on all generated documents.
3
Pipeline configuration
Your specialist maps your existing stage names — buyer pipeline, supplier pipeline, or unified flow.
4
Invite your team
Settings → Team members. Invite by email, assign roles. Each invitation uses one seat from your plan.
5
Product catalog setup
Your specialist imports your product list and configures USD baselines and FX pricing — catalog is quote-ready from day one.
6
Digital vCards
Each user configures their vCard. Specialist helps download QR codes for events and email signatures.
7
Contact import
Your specialist converts your existing data — any format — to SETU Flow. You review and approve before importing.
8
First quote walk-through
Live session: catalog product selection, FX currency, approval routing, and proforma PDF — confirmed end-to-end.
Most teams are fully live within 3–5 business days of activation.
Getting started
Users & roles
Three roles control what each person can see and do — governing data visibility, edit permissions, and approval authority.
Admin
Full access · Organisation management
Manages team members, settings, module access, and billing. Sees all contacts, quotes, orders, and activity. Max 2 admins recommended.
Manager
Org-wide view · Approval authority
Views and edits all contacts and deals. Assigns tasks, approves quotes, advances order stages. Cannot change billing or team composition.
Field rep
Own records · Create & capture
Sees their own contacts and assigned tasks. Creates leads, logs follow-ups, builds quotes — quotes require manager approval before sending.
Deactivating a user does not delete their records. Contacts, quotes, and orders remain and can be reassigned to another active rep by an Admin.

Trade lifecycle
SETU Flow maps to the full B2B trade commercial cycle — for importers, exporters, and distributors across any commodity and any market.
1
Capture
Meet a buyer, supplier, or distributor at a trade event, exhibition, or inbound enquiry. Capture via vCard exchange, QR scan, Smart Scan, or manual entry.
2
Follow-up
Log the interaction, assign a pipeline stage, and use Setu Guru to draft your first follow-up email within 48 hours. Assign task ownership.
3
Qualification
Qualify the contact — product interest, target price, volume, incoterm, payment terms, and timeline. Move to Qualified in your pipeline.
4
Quote
Build a proforma from the catalog with FX pricing. Get internal approval. Send the branded PDF. Setu Guru reviews readiness on Growth+.
5
Order execution
Accepted quote converts to an order. Track production, shipment, document readiness, and payment. Operations and commercial see the same live status.
6
Closeout
Mark the order settled. Log final notes. Contact moves to active accounts pool — ready for repeat outreach.
Works across all trade categories — food, industrial goods, textiles, chemicals, consumer products, and more.

Reference
FAQ
Common questions from SETU Flow clients during setup and daily operations.
Is SETU Flow only for food and agriculture?
No. SETU Flow works for any import, export, or distribution team — food, industrial goods, textiles, chemicals, consumer products, raw materials, and more.
What is the difference between Starter and Growth?
Starter ($199/month, up to 5 users) covers leads, catalog, and quote management. Growth ($499/month, up to 10 users) adds FX pricing, quote approval workflow, document manager, order execution, dispatch integration, and Setu Guru quote and document insights. All plans include vCard, mobile, trade events, and Guru AI.
How does FX pricing work?
Set your USD baseline per product in the catalog once. When building a quote in another currency (AED, EUR, GBP, AUD, etc.), SETU Flow applies current exchange rates automatically. Products with missing FX prices are flagged as Pricing Gap so you always know what needs pricing before quoting.
Is the mobile app included in all plans?
Yes. iOS and Android apps are included with every plan at no extra cost. Full access to leads, capture, quotes, orders, tasks, vCard, and Setu Guru — synced in real time with the web platform.
Can I import contacts from Excel or another CRM?
Yes, with no format restrictions. Your dedicated specialist converts your data from any format. You review and approve before anything is imported. Large catalogues are handled in batches.
Is my data secure?
Yes. All data is organisation-scoped with row-level security — no other SETU Flow client can access your contacts, quotes, documents, or orders. Data is stored on encrypted cloud infrastructure and never used to train AI models.
Who do I contact for support?
Email help@setugroups.com with your organisation name and issue description. SLA is under 24 hours with global time zone coverage.
